recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to THO conformance-expectation or Extension Pack bindings should be handled in those repositories and coordinated with the existing capabilitystatement-prohibited guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-40228 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue asking to add SHALL-NOT to the ConformanceExpectation CodeSystem and ValueSet while avoiding non-modifier CapabilityStatement expectation semantics by using separate prohibition handling.
initial_application: Commit f094b0ede945 added SHALL-NOT to source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-conformance-expectation.xml for FHIR-40228. The active conformance-expectation ValueSet composes all codes from that CodeSystem, and combined-branch commit 5e7f54f0df later corrected the malformed SHALL-NOT definition while reconciling FHIR-29593.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement and the conformance-expectation ValueSet are active in source/fhir.ini. The CapabilityStatement extension pieces are now in the FHIR Extension Pack: capabilitystatement-expectation directs SHALL NOT use to capabilitystatement-prohibited, and capabilitystatement-prohibited is a modifier extension. FHIR-44609 published that cross-reference clarification, and the FHIR-40228 Jira comment notes that the extension uses THO terminology so those changes are tied to THO/extension handling.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source change was made. The core CodeSystem and ValueSet already satisfy the seed issue, and adding a new core capability-expectation artifact would be inconsistent with the current Extension Pack/THO ownership model.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published Vocabulary issue also requested SHALL-NOT in ConformanceExpectation; it is already represented on the combined branch by commit 5e7f54f0df.
Published FHIR-extensions issue clarified that capabilitystatement-expectation and capabilitystatement-prohibited should cross-reference each other for prohibited expectations.
